policy: kill first; SPAN_UNDERIVED candidates are ineligible (R377 evidence-derivation requirement); R397 Phase 2: DOES_NOT_BEAT_BASELINE and PLAUSIBILITY_BOUND_VIOLATED candidates are ineligible for release (the machine's own physics gates the claim); among survivors prefer better E15-B verdict, then BEATS_BASELINE, then fewer deficient areas, then fewer UNCERTAIN attack outcomes; NO numeric score is computed (CEO standing rule: no new scoring systems)

ranked.mechanism: The paper's title and context imply that during cold start conditions, the ion current profile in the first combustion cycle deviates significantly due to poor mixture preparation, leading to misfire events characterized by weak or absent ionization charge in the initial spark cycles.
ranked.intervention: Implement a cold-temperature compensation strategy in the ignition system ECU that increases spark duration and advances spark timing specifically for sub-zero ambient temperatures to ensure reliable first-cycle ignition in the Toyota Corolla 2019.

ranked.mechanism: The paper investigates the correlation between misfire events and the quality of ignition (spark energy and initial flame kernel growth) during the first combustion cycle in cold conditions, using modified tandem ion current detection to characterize the physical process of combustion instability.
ranked.intervention: Implement a diagnostic strategy that monitors ion current signals specifically during the first combustion cycle after cold start to distinguish between insufficient spark energy, delayed auto-ignition, and fuel mixture stratification, thereby isolating the root cause of the cold-temperature misfire.

ranked.mechanism: Tandem ion current detection enabling additional spark ignition during the first combustion cycle to prevent misfire
ranked.intervention: Install a modified form tandem ion current detection system on the 2019 Toyota Corolla ignition circuit to trigger an additional spark when ion current indicates incomplete combustion below zero degrees Celsius

ranked.mechanism: Fuel viscosity and flow properties degrade as temperature decreases, leading to filter clogging and injection instability that compromises fuel delivery for combustion
ranked.intervention: Strengthen filtration and implement maintenance practices to mitigate FAME-rich blend clogging, or recalibrate the injection system on an energy basis for HVO-rich fuels
